scientific_name: Phaeomoniella chlamydospora, Phaeoacremonium spp., Fomitiporia mediterranea
description: Esca is a serious trunk disease of grapevines that damages wood tissues and reduces vine vigor. It causes leaf discoloration, wood decay, and sudden vine death in severe cases.
symptoms: Yellow and brown tiger-stripe patterns on leaves
Leaf drying and burning from margins
Reduced vine growth and weak shoots
White spongy rot inside the trunk
Sudden wilting or death of vines (apoplexy)
spread: Fungal spores entering through pruning wounds
biological_control: Trichoderma-based products applied to pruning wounds
Beneficial fungi to prevent pathogen colonization
prevention: Protect pruning wounds immediately after pruning
